title: [v1] Avoid computing an unused model loss during SFT
head: 466428c0fcbcf0289524bde8aba6a0077ccf103f
scope: Real GPT-2/Llama FP32/64 loss and gradient equivalence, masked fractional supervision, actual SFTTrainer.fit accumulated SGD/AdamW updates with optimizer/scheduler state, direct model label-loss controls.

measurements.interpretation: CPU profiler operator output allocation; not process peak memory or GPU throughput

peer_review: existing_prs reviewed original complete source diff and tests; final head changes only reference scheduler setup/step/state comparison to match complete optimizer metadata.

dedup_review.notes: Actual source and related changes inspected; no existing correction of passing labels to the logits-only v1 forward. Separate DPO dropout proposal #10779 was rejected as already open.

body:
## Problem

`BaseTrainer.compute_log_probs()` forwards `labels` to the causal language model, which computes its built-in loss. The trainer then ignores that loss and computes unreduced cross entropy from the logits for its own weighted SFT objective.

This performs an unnecessary second cross-entropy/log-softmax operation for every ordinary SFT microbatch.

## Change

Exclude only `labels` from the model-forward inputs in `compute_log_probs()`. Keep the labels for the trainer's shifted token loss and preserve all other tensor inputs, including attention masks, position IDs, and the existing multimodal position handling.

## Validation

[Native CPU before/after run](https://github.com/Afloat16/LlamaFactory/actions/runs/43419756594) for commit `466428c0fcbcf0289524bde8aba6a0077ccf103f`, with PyTorch 2.9.1+cpu and Transformers 4.57.1:

- Baseline: 12 failures and 2 passing controls. Fixed: all 14 new cases pass.
- All 8 existing DPO precision and chunk-loss cases pass.
- Actual GPT-2 and Llama models in FP32 and FP64, dense and sparse label masking, padding, fractional token weights, and non-default attention/position inputs.
- Weighted loss and every parameter gradient exactly match an independent explicit weighted cross-entropy reference. The caller's batch remains unchanged.
- Two real `SFTTrainer.fit()` updates with gradient accumulation, using both SGD and AdamW, match reference model parameters and complete optimizer/scheduler state.
- Direct model calls with labels continue to produce their normal built-in loss.
- Native profiler: cross-entropy calls per tested microbatch fall from **2 to 1**. For the 2 × 7-token, 10-token-vocabulary fixtures, cumulative log-softmax output allocations fall from **1,040 to 480 bytes**.
- Ruff check, Ruff format, and diff whitespace checks pass.

The allocation measurement is the CPU profiler's operator-allocation total for the stated fixtures, rather than process peak memory or a GPU throughput benchmark.
